    hamiltonian = FermyOperator(mol)

    optimizer = CbcStrategy(bqm_provider=None)  # Use CBC for optimization
    vqe = VQE(hamiltonian, optimizer)

    # Prepare the problem for the VQE algorithm
    vqe.problem = vqe.hamiltonian
